about_the_game:
Game storyline:

In this work, you play the role of a wealthy young man and will encounter at least five young ladies with different styles.

Some of them are clever, some have deep scheming, some are rebellious, and some are heroic. When advancing the plot of each female character, you will face multiple choices with different endings. Whether to choose to be a scumbag and hurt them fiercely, or to be a good man and slowly enter their hearts, it all depends on your own thoughts.

Character Growth:

The game not only sets a favorability system for each female character, but also sets "Playboy Potential" points for the character played by the player. When the player's Playboy Potential is too high, it will trigger some special plot that only Playboy can experience, which may not be what the player expects. All behaviors that are not good to female characters in the game will increase the Playboy Potential.

Goal and Challenge:

There are three female characters in the game and the player has a fairy tale ending, but in order to achieve it, corresponding likability requirements need to be met. If players are very greedy, they will have nothing.

Game features:

Different from traditional cartoon style GAL games, this game uses 3D character images, each character has dozens of micro expression changes, which are more vivid and the graphics are more realistic. The game script is written by the Famous internet literature writer. The core of the story focuses on the contemporary Chinese society, and the writing is more in line with the Chinese reading habits. What can be guaranteed is that, regardless of the quality of the story, most players will experience a sense of pleasure from the story, which is the insistence of the writers.

content_descriptors.notes: The game contains only mild nudity and no sexual content.

name: 渣男游戏

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS *: Microsoft® Windows® 7/8/8.1/10 (64bit)
  • Processor: intel CORE i3-3200及以上
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GT730 及以上

Recommended:

  • OS *: Microsoft® Windows® 7/8/8.1/10 (64bit)

short_description: 在《渣男游戏》里，你是一名年少多金的大帅哥，你会遇到许多性格迥异的美女，在与她们的相处过程中，是用渣男手段讨她们的欢心，还是用真诚得到她们的真爱，选择权在你手里。
